history.content: i dont really know why im here. felt kind of empty after i got off the phone with my dad. like nothing. is that weird
Not weird. That sounds more like emptiness or going a bit blank after the call, and I’m glad you said it plainly.

maybe not empty actually. hm. its just that we usually argue. every call for years its been tense. and this one we just talked about his garden and it was fine. i kept waiting for the bad part and it didnt come
That waiting for the bad part, and it never arriving, feels important. I’m wondering if what showed up was more like relief, uncertainty, or something else entirely?
yeah. relief. thats the word. like i can finally put something down i didnt know i was holding. he sounded happy about the tomatoes lol
Yeah, relief fits. It sounds like you could finally set something down, and his happiness about the tomatoes gave the call a softer ending.
yeah. thanks for this. i feel lighter than when i opened it. gonna go text him back about the tomatoes
I’m glad it landed softly. Enjoy the tomatoes, and take the lighter note with you.
